unresolved_content.primary_instruction: Aux a, b et c du 4° et à l’avant-dernier alinéa, les mots « de soixante ans » sont remplacés par « de soixante-deux ans ».
unresolved_content.finding: The penultimate paragraph is L(A). The canonical XML still defines it at sixty, while A is sixty-two. The recovered graphic itself uses L(A), without numerical age. No silent change is made.
unresolved_content.resolution: Held: full canonical version concordance cannot be certified. Parent to independently review the explicit discrepancy; no canonical correction authorized here.

concordance.finding: Seven textual/reference corrections; none changes E graphic.
2006 changes projected ceiling increments and B date definition, plus transitional 2006 B rule; no E operator change.
2008 changes acceptance-date wording to request-date wording; no E operator change.
2010 changes formula 57→55, changes A to 62, and expressly changes sixty to sixty-two at the penultimate paragraph. This last instruction conflicts with canonical L(A) wording.
2015 changes mortality table reference and D 167→172; no E operator change and no resolution of L(A) wording discrepancy.
